fullPassage: Fritz Pollard was an American football player and coach who broke many boundaries throughout his career. It started when he joined the Brown University football team in 1915. Being African American, Pollard wasn't accepted by his teammates at first. However, his skill and charisma changed their minds, and Pollard led Brown to a record of eight wins and one loss the following year. In 1920, Pollard became the first African American quarterback in the pro football league and won the championship with his team, the Akron Pros. The next year, he became the first African American head coach in the National Football League, and he continued to coach and play until 1926. His playing days being behind him, Pollard then organized and began coaching the Chicago Black Hawks, an all-African American professional football team, in 1928. Pollard finally retired from football in 1937.

questions.passage: Fritz Pollard was an American football player and coach who broke many boundaries throughout his career. It started when he joined the Brown University football team in 1915. Being African American, Pollard wasn't accepted by his teammates at first. However, his skill and charisma changed their minds, and Pollard led Brown to a record of eight wins and one loss the following year. In 1920, Pollard became the first African American quarterback in the pro football league and won the championship with his team, the Akron Pros. The next year, he became the first African American head coach in the National Football League, and he continued to coach and play until 1926. His playing days being behind him, Pollard then organized and began coaching the Chicago Black Hawks, an all-African American professional football team, in 1928. Pollard finally retired from football in 1937.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ③이 본문과 불일치: 1926년 이후에도 팀을 조직·지도했고 최종 은퇴는 1937년
det.analysis:
① 일치 — 최초의 흑인 쿼터백·감독 등 'broke many boundaries(여러 최초 기록)'와 맞아요.

② 일치 — 'organized ... the Chicago Black Hawks, an all-African American professional football team, in 1928(1928년 흑인 프로 팀 조직)'과 맞아요.

③ 불일치 — 그는 1926년까지 지도·선수로 활동한 뒤 1928년에 새 팀을 만들었고, '최종 은퇴는 1937년(retired from football in 1937)'이에요. '1926년에 완전히 은퇴'는 사실과 달라 이것이 정답이에요 ←정답

④ 일치 — 'led Brown to a record of eight wins and one loss(8승 1패의 성적으로 이끌었다)'와 맞아요.
det.tip: 최종 은퇴는 1937년. '1926년 완전 은퇴'는 틀림(불일치)

questions.passage: ①Being an African American, Pollard was not welcomed by his teammates at first. However, his talent soon ②changed their attitude toward him. In 1920, he ③led his team to a professional championship as its quarterback. Years later, he ④organizing a new all-Black football team in Chicago.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 어법상 틀린 것을 고르시오.

det.korean: ④ organizing → organized: 문장의 본동사 자리이므로 과거형 organized. 분사 organizing은 본동사 불가
det.analysis:
① Being — '① Being an African American, Pollard was not welcomed(아프리카계 미국인이었기 때문에 환영받지 못했다)'은 이유를 나타내는 분사구문, 적절해요.

② changed — 'his talent soon ② changed their attitude(그의 재능이 태도를 바꿨다)' 과거시제 본동사, 적절해요.

③ led — 'he ③ led his team to a championship(팀을 우승으로 이끌었다)' 과거시제, 적절해요.

④ organizing — 'Years later, he ④ organizing a new team(여러 해 뒤 그는 새 팀을 조직했다)'에서 이 문장에는 본동사가 없어요. 주어 he 뒤에는 -ing형이 아니라 과거형 organized(본동사)가 와야 해요 → 틀려요 ←정답
det.tip: 주어(he) 뒤 본동사 자리 = 정동사(organized). -ing(organizing)는 본동사 불가
